Request body
wan2.7-r2v, wan2.7-r2v-2026-06-12
prompt string (Required)
Image 1
Video 1
first_frame
reference_video
A maximum of 1 first frame image.
Reference images + Reference videos ≤ 5
resolution string
720P and 1080P
ratio string
16:9 (default) 9:16 1:1 4:3 3:4
duration integer
default value is 5
includes a video, the value must be an integer from 2 to 10
does not include a video, the value must be an integer from 2 to 15
